services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs

services.title: Boiler Installation & Servicing

services.title: Central Heating Maintenance

services.title: Drain Cleaning & Unblocking

about_pullquote: I built this business to solve plumbing emergencies properly, not just patch them.
about_para_1: Aquallis Plumbing was founded on a simple principle: when you ring a plumber, you need someone who picks up, arrives fast, and fixes it right. After 15 years serving Coventry and the surrounding areas, we've built a reputation for honest pricing, transparent diagnostics, and no-fuss emergency response. Our team has trained extensively in modern heating systems, drainage technology, and customer service—because the best plumbing is the kind that lets you forget about your pipes.
about_para_2: We're locals who understand Coventry's housing stock and the real challenges homeowners face. Repeat customers make up over 60% of our work, which tells us we're doing something right. Whether it's a midnight burst pipe or a routine boiler service, you'll get the same professionalism and fair pricing every time. We're proud to be independent and owner-managed—your emergency genuinely is our priority.
reviews_heading: What Coventry Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolute lifesaver. Pipe burst in my kitchen at 11pm on a Sunday. Rang Aquallis and someone was at the door within 50 minutes. Turned off the water, dried everything out, and got me a temporary fix. Came back Monday morning and did the proper repair. Proper lads, fair prices, no messing about.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had my boiler serviced and they found a crack in the heat exchanger before it caused real trouble. They explained everything clearly and sourced a replacement without any price shock. Very thorough and you can see they know their stuff. Will use them for my next emergency, fingers crossed I don't need one.
reviews.author: Janet K.

reviews.text: Blocked drain nightmare just before the in-laws arrived. Aquallis came the same day, used their camera to show me exactly where the blockage was, and cleared it out. No damage, no mess. Really professional outfit. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend.
reviews.author: David P.
